name: reef-raiders
description: Reef Raiders — professional web-based fish-shooting arcade gaming platform (virtual DEMO COINS only).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @reef/shared && npm run build -w @reef/server && npm run build -w @reef/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @reef/shared && npm run typecheck -w @reef/server && npm run typecheck -w @reef/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @reef/server && npm run test -w @reef/web
